title: GS21 leverage U with continuous firm-level debt capacity, gs_bv 0.5, bounded exposure (gs_bv_cap 2)
question: gvylq20 at 2.5x the loading, with the exposure bounded: is a U in leverage large enough to clear the bar?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-03). gvylq10/20 (gs_bv 0.1/0.2) left room of about 7%: with the coupon uniform on [0.1, 0.9], b~^2 - 1 spans only [-1, 0.9], so the exposure ranged about +-0.2 (gvyzzh10's productivity curvature spans to about 8 and had room 70%). gs_bv 0.5 scales it to [-0.50, 0.45], with gs_bv_cap 2 so the exposed claim keeps a finite value (gvyslz e/f). U-shaped (distress and credit rationing at the extremes).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-03): the premium across leverage quintiles is U-shaped; room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
